references.text: Moses warns that the people will eat their own children during extreme famine caused by enemy siege, as a consequence of disobedience to God.
Jeremiah prophesies that the people will eat the flesh of their sons and daughters during the siege of Jerusalem.
Lamentations describes how women ate their own children during the destruction of Jerusalem, fulfilling this curse.
Merciful women cooked their own children when the daughter of Zion was destroyed, a horrific fulfillment of this curse.
Ezekiel prophesies that fathers will eat their children and children their fathers in Jerusalem because of their sins.
During the siege of Samaria, two women ate their sons, a historical fulfillment of the curse.
